backups.title: Manual backup
backups.intro: Create an encrypted package of the PostgreSQL database and the private documents actually stored.
backups.encryptionInfo: Backups are encrypted and kept in a private local folder, without anonymous downloads. Success means a completed capture, not a tested restore.
backups.phraseWarning: First backup: choose a recovery phrase different from your administrator password. Store it safely. If both this phrase and the local key are lost, encrypted backups may be unrecoverable.
backups.phraseHelp: At least 20 characters. This phrase protects a recovery copy of the key included in each backup package. Later backups will not request it again.
backups.failed: Backup failed: no incomplete package is considered valid.
backups.notRestored: A completed backup is not a verified restore. A restore in an isolated environment must be tested before claiming recoverability.
backups.inventoryIntro: Each package is verified on disk when viewed. Cached statuses are never treated as evidence.
backups.integrityOnly: Restore in a test environment: not performed
backups.notVerified: This package has not passed integrity verification. Do not treat it as a verified backup.
backups.retentionScope: Initial value: 30 days. Only verified encrypted packages inside SMN's private managed storage are affected. Changing the duration never deletes anything automatically.
backups.retentionRevision: Policy revision: {revision}. Every change is audited.
backups.retentionSaved: Retention duration saved and audited. The new rule will apply to future cleanups.
backups.retentionInvalid: Invalid duration: enter an integer between 1 and 3650 days.
backups.retentionConflict: The policy or backups have changed. Reload the inventory and try again.
backups.retentionFailed: Could not save the duration. Previous value retained.
backups.cleanupPreview: Integrity-verified backups eligible for cleanup: {count}. Nothing is deleted without confirmation.
backups.cleanupConfirm: Permanently delete {count} verified, expired managed backup(s)? Exported copies and business archives will not be affected.
backups.cleanupFailed: Cleanup not confirmed. Check the inventory and audit trail before retrying.
backups.externalDisclaimer: Business PDF/TXT files and Vn snapshots are excluded. SMN cannot monitor or delete backups exported outside managed storage.
backups.retentionUnsaved: Save or revert the pending duration change before starting cleanup.

assignment.heading: Dated assignment and roles
assignment.intro: This assignment belongs to the single team. Changes are saved as new effective-dated versions, without rewriting past versions.

assignment.rules: Role shares must total exactly 100%. Team allocation must not exceed contracted time. A 0% Developer share does not contribute any development capacity. Changes are not retroactive.
assignment.saved: The new version was saved and the history preserved.
assignment.invalidShares: Check percentages: whole numbers from 0 to 100, total role shares 100%, team allocation at most the contracted time.

assignment.conflict: Cannot save: revision conflict, invalid effective date or closed assignment. Reload before trying again.
assignment.notFound: The member or team is unavailable.
assignment.failed: Save could not be confirmed. Check history before retrying.
assignment.historyNote: Corrections on the same day retain every revision; the latest applies to that date. A future version takes effect only on its chosen date.

lifecycle.failedLoad: Could not reload the record after the action.

lifecycle.reactivateConfirm: Reactivate the member without automatically reopening any previous assignment?
lifecycle.deleteConfirm: Final confirmation: permanently delete this empty record?

regionalAbsence.noApplicableAssignment: No applicable Scrum/Kanban assignment on this date. The absence remains on the member's record and is not attributed to a team.

teamCalendar.title: Team calendar
teamCalendar.adminIntro: Review availability and members’ absence categories and reasons, then create or edit records in their central profile.
teamCalendar.userIntro: Authorized collective view: consolidated staffing and unavailability, without identities, reasons or sensitive individual details.
teamCalendar.filtersHint: Single Scrum/Kanban team in the MVP. All roles can filter the period; identity, category and absence-type filters are restricted to administrators.
teamCalendar.loadFailed: The team calendar could not be loaded.
teamCalendar.available: Members with at least one known available slot
teamCalendar.collectiveHint: A person is counted at most once per day even when national holidays and multiple absences overlap. Unknown availability is not treated as zero. These counts are not development capacity in person-days.
teamCalendar.adminFilterHint: Category and type filters limit the displayed absence records only; overall availability and collective counts are still computed from all actual absences.
teamCalendar.noMembers: No members assigned to the team during this period.
teamCalendar.categoryHint: The category is always shown as text, not just by colour. Absence reasons are available to administrators only.
teamCalendar.centralHint: This editor operates directly on the member's central record: creating or editing an absence here also updates their personal calendar, without duplicates. Changes are audited.

companyClosures.title: Company-wide closure days
companyClosures.intro: Closure days apply to the team without creating individual absences. They are independent of national holidays and personal absences. Historical corrections are audited.
companyClosures.name: Closure name
companyClosures.auditHint: Each correction is dated and audited. To cancel a closure, uncheck 'Closure is active'. Frozen initial capacities and archived PDFs are never silently recalculated.
companyClosures.created: Company closure saved without creating personal absences.
companyClosures.saved: Closure updated and a new revision was saved.
companyClosures.invalidDate: Invalid date or inconsistent period. No change was saved.
companyClosures.conflict: Another user changed this closure. Reload the page.
companyClosures.overlap: The period overlaps another active closure. Edit or cancel the other closure first.
companyClosures.failed: Unable to confirm the save. Reload and retry.

developmentCapacity.title: Development capacity in person-days
developmentCapacity.intro: Dynamic reference by date range, independent of Sprints and Kanban. No value is written to frozen historical snapshots.
developmentCapacity.settingsHint: 8 hours by default. Between 1 and 24 with up to two decimals. Changes are audited and do not modify archived PDFs or closed Sprints.
developmentCapacity.invalidHours: Choose a valid value between 1 and 24 hours, with up to two decimal places.
developmentCapacity.conflict: The setting changed elsewhere. Reload this page before saving.
developmentCapacity.invalidPeriod: Invalid date range: check the dates and the 93-day limit.
developmentCapacity.loadError: Unable to calculate capacity. Check installation and data completeness.
developmentCapacity.notCalculable: Not calculable / Not supplied — review missing sources.
developmentCapacity.noAssignments: No known assignment during this period.
developmentCapacity.assignmentVersion: Assignment version or historical percentage missing.
developmentCapacity.memberCountry: Member country not known for this date.
developmentCapacity.nationalCoverage: National holiday coverage insufficient or unknown.
developmentCapacity.disclaimer: Availability × allocation rate × Developer role share × contribution coefficient. Contract rate is not multiplied again because it already bounds allocation. Story Points are never converted to person-days, nor are Sprints or Kanban indicators created automatically.

manualCapacity.zeroHint: 0 person-days is a valid explicit value. To return to calculated mode, use 'Clear manual entry': emptying the input text is not enough.
manualCapacity.saved: Manual capacity saved; it remains authoritative when the reference is recalculated.
manualCapacity.cleared: Manual entry cleared and audited. The calculated reference is used again if reliable.
manualCapacity.protected: Period closed or initial capacity frozen: direct editing is blocked. Use the authorized reopening or historical-adjustment workflow once available.
manualCapacity.invalid: Enter a nonnegative number of person-days with up to 4 decimal places; the field cannot be blank.
manualCapacity.conflict: This period changed since you opened it. Recalculate to load the current revision.
manualCapacity.failed: Unable to confirm the save. Reload the period before trying again.

initialCapacity.title: Initial capacity frozen at the actual opening
initialCapacity.notOpened: Period not opened: no initial snapshot has been recorded.
initialCapacity.immutable: This initial snapshot is immutable. Later absences and corrections do not overwrite it.
initialCapacity.openHint: This explicit business operation records the actual opening time, freezes the retained capacity and blocks direct manual edits. Merely viewing the theoretical date does not open the period. A fully past period without original evidence is frozen as 'Not supplied'.
initialCapacity.confirm: Confirm the actual opening of this period? This freezes the initial reference and prevents reconstructing it from later changes.
initialCapacity.failed: The opening could not be confirmed. Reload the period before trying again.

actualCapacity.title: Actual observed development capacity
actualCapacity.intro: Team-wide actuals are separate from the initial commitment. The observed reference covers completed days only; no personal performance or Story Points are inferred.
actualCapacity.noFuture: No actuals: the period is upcoming. Future workdays are never extrapolated.
actualCapacity.gapUnknown: Not displayed: initial commitment or actual capacity is unknown.
actualCapacity.zeroHint: Zero person-days is an explicit manual actual. An empty field is not zero. Clear the entry to return to a reliable calculated reference.
actualCapacity.saved: Manual actual saved; it remains authoritative after recalculation.
actualCapacity.cleared: Manual actual cleared and audited. The observed reference is used again.
actualCapacity.invalid: Enter a nonnegative person-day value with at most 4 decimals.
actualCapacity.protected: Closed period: no direct changes allowed.
actualCapacity.conflict: A concurrent change occurred. Reload the period.
actualCapacity.failed: The operation could not be confirmed. Reload the period.
actualCapacity.closeHint: Closing freezes the retained actual and its current reference. Only fully completed periods may be closed; archived PDFs are never rewritten.
actualCapacity.confirmClose: Permanently close actual capacity for this period? The saved snapshot will be immutable and direct edits blocked.
actualCapacity.closedImmutable: Closed actual capacity is immutable. Closed on:
actualCapacity.noIndividualJudgment: The gap describes team capacity variation, never an individual performance score.

historicalQuality.title: Historical capacity reliability
historicalQuality.intro: Retrospective quality is separate from the initial commitment and from Calculation/Manual source. A numerical estimate is not automatically known fact.
historicalQuality.notHistorical: This form is available only for fully completed periods.
historicalQuality.estimatedWarning: Estimate only: not equivalent to a known initial commitment.
historicalQuality.evidenceHint: Known requires an identifiable source (document, import or other reference). Estimated stays estimated, with a documented method. Not supplied requires a reason; no value is invented. Existing snapshots and PDFs are never changed.
historicalQuality.comparisonUnknown: Not calculated: planned capacity unknown/estimated or actual not available.
historicalQuality.comparisonCaution: This contextual team-level retrospective comparison is distinct from the frozen original commitment. No individual performance grading.
historicalQuality.invalid: Check the amount (zero allowed), source (at least 3 characters) and explanation (at least 5 characters). Reconstruction cannot be marked Known.
historicalQuality.conflict: The qualification changed elsewhere. Reload before retrying.
historicalQuality.saveError: Unable to save the qualification. Reload the period.
historicalQuality.saved: Quality saved with source and revision history.
historicalQuality.historyLimit: Only the last 100 revisions are shown. Complete history remains stored in the database.

replanning.title: Preview capacity replanning
replanning.intro: Compare current and proposed period bounds without saving anything before explicit confirmation.
replanning.manualNotice: Manual values, including zero, remain with the original period. The After value is only a proposal and is not copied to the target period.
replanning.unsaved: PREVIEW ONLY: no new period bounds have been saved.
replanning.savedTarget: Proposal confirmed and audited in the capacity planning register.
replanning.blockTarget: Another period already uses the proposed bounds: no implicit merge.
replanning.blockSame: Proposed and current dates are identical.
replanning.blockMissing: One or more references cannot be calculated: no fabricated zero.
replanning.confirmQuestion: Confirm new capacity planning bounds? Existing manual capacity and historical snapshots are not altered; future Scrum/Kanban cycles require separate integration.
replanning.confirmed: Capacity planning target confirmed and audited.
replanning.scopeNotice: This confirmation stores a capacity planning target, not the change to an operational Sprint or Kanban period (future Epics 4/7). No archived PDF or historical snapshot is rewritten.
replanning.errorCalculation: Not calculable: missing capacity data or computation unavailable. Nothing saved.
replanning.errorNoPeriod: Unknown period. Recalculate or save a capacity entry for this range.
replanning.errorPreview: Unable to preview these dates. Check their order and length (93 days maximum).
replanning.errorClosed: Period closed. Authorized reopening is required.
replanning.errorStale: Capacity data or dates changed: nothing saved. Refresh the preview.
replanning.errorConfirm: Confirmation failed; no successful save has been established.

prefill.savedContext: Country and location loaded from the saved record. A deliberately empty country remains empty.
prefill.suggestedCountry: Country suggested from installation settings; confirm or change it. Not saved at this stage.
prefill.unknownCountry: Country unknown: no location or country has been fabricated.
prefill.savedWeek: Working week loaded from the latest saved version.
prefill.suggestedWeek: Suggested working week (Monday to Friday). Not saved until you select Save.
prefill.savedAssignment: Assignment values loaded from the saved version. Each field remains editable.
prefill.suggestedAssignment: Suggested, editable initial role distribution; not saved yet.
prefill.optionalProfile: The provisional name remains until you confirm it. Email is optional and does not block other features.
prefill.noInventedAbsence: Viewing the selected date does not create an absence. No category or reason is inferred automatically. Only Save creates an absence.
prefill.unknownPeriod: No operational period is inferred from today's date. Select the dates of the period to consult.
prefill.unsavedCapacity: You have edited a manual capacity without saving it. Save or discard your changes before updating settings.

centralCalendar.title: Shared central calendar
centralCalendar.readOnly: Read-only view: items come from their source records. Filtering and browsing never move events, and drag-and-drop is not enabled.
centralCalendar.singleTeam: Single-team MVP: only the authorized team can be viewed.
centralCalendar.noCycles: No operational cycle is recorded in the current repository. No fabricated cycles are displayed.
centralCalendar.noMeetings: No Agile meetings are currently recorded. Past meetings are not assumed to have taken place.
centralCalendar.noItems: No items of the selected type in this period.
centralCalendar.aggregate: {count} member(s) with reported unavailability (no personal details)

scrumCadence.title: Scrum team cadence
scrumCadence.intro: Set defaults for newly created Sprints. Existing Sprints, including future ones, keep their dates.
scrumCadence.futureOnly: These settings only apply to Sprints created after this change.
scrumCadence.saveError: Unable to save cadence. Check days and hours.
scrumCadence.conflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Reload the page.
